uncertain: Ext. Pins: the physical pins sit on the end face and are not visible; the callout dots are not tied to drawn pins, so positions follow the order of the callout list and the back-label column (GND 5V 14 17 42 40)
PORT.A: the callout list beside the bottom view is matched to the Grove connector by proximity and the back-label column (GND 5V G2 G1); the individual contacts are not drawn
notes: Back-label notes RGB:G35, BTN:G41, CLK:G39 DAT:G38 (mic), DN:G19 DP:G20 and IR LED:G12 are internal assignments, not header pins. USB-A plug skipped.
